protocol.primary: paired free-rollout residual, same windows as measured response
protocol.initialization: Only first n measured outputs/input histories, n=model order. No fitted initial state, no trend or disturbance fitting, no output feedback correction.
protocol.aggregation: Unchanged maximum over all first-2/3 5-second windows, same10 frequencies and threshold1. No gain caps, radius scaling or dropping windows.
protocol.selection: Frozen same identified model for both gates; current C# search and nominal Schur test unchanged.
protocol.holdout: Final third residual spectra audited only after selection; never used to pick gate settings.
protocol.synthetic: 72 cases x single30/repeat2/repeat4; no measurement noise; plant truth only in grading.
protocol.game: Two Duster, two older Spirit, one latest Spirit log. Historical selected models frozen; no future other-axis observations.
protocol.limitations: Empirical residual envelope, not guaranteed uncertainty coverage. Same model affine offset for all records; mismatch is not fitted away. Perfect finite-window equality is necessary, not sufficient, for robustness.

exploratoryVariants.warmup: After primary rejected known-good Spirit, initial state only fitted to first 2s (existing IV history length), same free residual envelope.
exploratoryVariants.equation: After warmup still rejected known-good Spirit, use A(q)y-B(q)u-offset residual divided spectrally by nominal A and U. Same windows, maximum, frequencies, threshold. No truth used in radius or search. Finite-window inversion approximate; no certified bound.
